review_scope: Public README, paper methods and public archive inventory only; zero bird-level data values opened.

external_system.observational_fact: Natal island and adult/recruitment island can be distinct per individual; source direction is more directly represented than same-cohort Glanville maternal sibling dyads.

annual_recruitment.publication_title: Metapopulation-level analyses reveal positive fitness consequences of immigration in a small bird
annual_recruitment.natal_label_origin: Individual identification via field capture-mark-recapture and/or SNP-based genetic assignment/pedigree; label-specific provenance/uncertainty not yet verified from physical files.
annual_recruitment.ecological_target_prior_art: Published analyses already compare fitness outcomes and recruitment of immigrant versus resident sparrows.

pedigree.note: This dictionary is advertised in the 2024 README; patch-code equivalence with the 2025 fitness tables has not been physically verified.
pedigree.island_name_spelling_boundary: The public 2024 README literally advertises code 27 as Hestmannøly. The expected place spelling Hestmannøy is not silently substituted until a source-backed crosswalk verifies the alias.

genetic_assignment.role: Previously published genetically assigned natal-source methodology, NOT a new EOG method or a ground-truth per-individual origin-error certificate.

field_process.paper_role: Prior art on spatial structure and dispersal dynamics in the same house-sparrow metapopulation.

observation_contract.comparison_with_v23: Closer empirical analogue of direction-aware source attribution for an individual than cross-patch sibling relationships, but NOT the v23 P_node earliest-source-of-node tag under an activation history.

possible_limited_follow_up.role: Separate explicitly RETROSPECTIVE channel-qualification analysis after response-independent physical schema/source-key verification; do not promote as confirmed EOG ecological source-loss result.
possible_limited_follow_up.defensible_question: Does individual natal-source information expose origin diversity of successful immigrants and recruits that aggregate island occupancy/counts cannot resolve, with island-year sampling effort and genetic assignment uncertainty explicitly modeled?
possible_limited_follow_up.prior_art_caveat: Immigrant vs resident fitness and dispersal success already reported by Saatoglu et al. 2025; this alone is not EOG novelty.
possible_limited_follow_up.strong_reference_class: Published dispersal/fecundity/survival models for this metapopulation, with count/effort, island habitat/farm status, and established distance/network connectivity baselines.
no_prospective_scoring_until: Freeze exact Dryad source file versions and physical headers without revealing bird-level outcomes.
Fix island and bird identifier/code dictionary joins across 2024 pedigree and 2025 recruitment tables.
Identify sample opportunity, individual capture/resighting detection process and island-year coverage independent of fitness outcomes.
Distinguish natal island established by nest/capture from inferred with assignment uncertainty; require no future-year information leakage.
Choose a genuinely new target not already answered by source paper, its strong comparator and a temporally separated validation strategy.
Mark pre-exposed published result directions as PRIOR_EXPOSURE so future analysis cannot claim blind preregistration.

terminal_decision.source_identity_conclusion: Public documentation supports a directional individual-level natal-dispersal variable; no original dataset byte or biological row was inspected.
excluded_claims: The first colonizing island source was identified.
EOG has new independently confirmed metapopulation persistence or survival benefit.
The existing immigrant fitness result is original to EOG.
